Crafted in deep blue cotton gabardine, it combines molding embroideries with a Dior embroidery as well as a ribbed hem. Showcasing a comfortable fit, the contemporary zipped shirt will create modern looks with pants from the collection.

713J496A2F58_C589.title: DiorAlps Dior Montaigne Jacket
713J496A2F58_C589.description: Part of the DiorAlps capsule, the Dior Montaigne jacket reimagines a classic outerwear staple with contemporary features. Crafted in blue technical fleece, it is accented with contrasting yellow zips and a signature honoring the House's iconic address on the chest patch pocket. The jacket will add a finishing touch to any sporty outfit.
